name: paper-daily
title_zh: 每天自动筛选 arXiv 上 LLM/Agent 新
tagline_zh: 早上打开电脑，它已按关键词和机构排好今日候选，挑出少量精品，直接喂给 llm-paper-daily 工作流。
tagline_en: Wake up to a shortlist of today's LLM/Agent papers, ranked by keywords and institutions, ready for your.
desc_en: Discover daily arXiv papers for LLM/Agent topics, rank candidates with keyword and institution filters, and prepare a small selected paper list for llm-paper-daily style workflows.
why_zh: 不是简单抓标题——它用关键词+机构双重过滤，把海量 arXiv 压成可读清单，省下你每天刷页面的半小时。
why_en: Not just a feed—it double-filters by keywords and institutions, compressing arXiv's flood into a readable shortlist, saving you.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 arXiv 的 cs.CL/cs.AI/cs.LG 分类；需要本机配置好 llm-paper-daily 的读。
limit_en: Only covers arXiv cs.CL/cs.AI/cs.LG; requires llm-paper-daily's reader env locally, else it outputs JSON only, no Markdown report.
